overview: This enum chooses the behavior package installed on a spawned trap.

None.simple: The trap has no chosen behavior.
None.technical: The header defines None as the zero value and TrapDataTable rows default to it. AGameTrapManager::InitializeTrap forwards the row value to SetTrapActionType. None has no case in that switch, so initialization installs no specialized behavior object.

VolcanoHoming.simple: The trap fires volcanic blasts that aim toward a target.
VolcanoHoming.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_VolcanoHoming. That behavior keeps a start transform, an effect transform aimed from the spine bone, a target pitch clamped between 0 and 30 degrees, and a shot count.

VolcanoOneShot.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_VolcanoOneShot. The behavior stores one effect handle and finishes on a hit while its state is zero or lower.

VolcanoTrigger.simple: The trap waits for a trigger and then erupts.
VolcanoTrigger.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_VolcanoTrigger. The behavior uses a charge effect, a marker effect, a ground trace, an enemy sweep, and a delayed eruption. CP_140 also uses this value to keep only the oldest trigger trap active.

FlowerMachineGun.simple: The trap fires a rapid volley from a flower mechanism.
FlowerMachineGun.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_FlowerMachineGun. The behavior watches FX_CP_150_06201, fades a Niagara component from 1 to 0 over 0.5 seconds, and exposes the played effect to the controller. CP_150 replaces the active trap and releases the trap shot when a new FlowerMachineGun trap spawns.

PlantRootMove.simple: A plant root bursts upward and spins.
PlantRootMove.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_PlantRootMove. The behavior starts with FX_CP_150_00213, rises from 0 to 3000 world units with EaseInOut, spins from -3600 to 0 degrees per second, and spawns ground burst effects.

PlantWall.simple: The trap raises a plant wall that can block and hit fighters.
PlantWall.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_PlantWall. The behavior starts FX_CP_150_08111, rises from 0 to 500 multiplied by unique float 7 with EaseInOut, enables collision, and routes hits through OnHit. CP_150 removes finished plant walls from every homing shot handle list.

BodyRepel.simple: The trap drags a trailing body chain behind itself.
BodyRepel.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_BodyRepel. Initialize collects mesh links from the root, UniqueAction lays them out behind the trap, and Tick drags each link 400 units multiplied by the trap X scale behind the previous link.

Uzumaki.simple: The trap becomes a whirlpool head that rises and lunges.
Uzumaki.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_Uzumaki. The behavior rises from a base, aims at the spawner target, lunges sideways, and trails a beam. It caches many spawner unique floats, plays CN_122_ATTACKI_03_01 at an offset of 1000 units on Y, and keeps a ground decal and ground effect.

IceWall.simple: The trap forms an ice wall with rising shards.
IceWall.technical: SetTrapActionType creates FGameTrapAction_IceWall. The behavior uses a decal, ground effect, two eased rise stages, and a timed finish. It enables attack collision and selects a damage row by trap row ID with a cursed energy level branch for CN_250_ATTACKG_01_01_1.

Invalid.technical: The header defines Invalid as the explicit 255 sentinel. The base trap action reports Invalid from GetActionType. SetTrapActionType has no case for Invalid, so it installs no specialized behavior.

notes: SetTrapActionType reuses an existing behavior when its GetActionType matches the requested value, and otherwise replaces it for the nine behavior values.
The available TrapDataTable export uses the nine behavior values only, with separate VolcanoHoming, VolcanoOneShot, and VolcanoTrigger rows and with repeated PlantWall, BodyRepel, and IceWall rows.
SpawnFlag and CursedEnergyLevel are stored separately on the trap and are not part of this enum.
